title: Rail8 connection of an environment, schemaVersion 1 (draft — review at hand-over)
description: One connection of an environment's configuration, as its export writes it and its import reads it, in a folder that is not a package, at connection/<key>.yaml. It holds references to secrets, never a value, and no state: no stop, revision, version, token, date, author, draft or consent. values are the fields of the adapter's connection form, a secret field as secret://<name>, and the platform's allowedHosts; the adapter's form checks them, not this schema. While mock is present the connection is mocked and its values are kept. secrets is written by the export for the reader: each secret the values name, with its kind and, for a key pair, its public facts; an import decides nothing from it.
